units: simulation world units; frames are zero-based attack ticks, excluding charge/hitlag pauses

derivedContext.di: none; launch vector is authored before DI

conditions.selection: lowest contacting region index wins; body capsule intersection or shield intersection
conditions.rehit: one hit per attacker/attack serial/window; a higher window permits another hit
conditions.smashCharge: grounded held attack pauses before first active frame; endpoints exported
conditions.start: beginFighterAttack enforces grounding and canStartAttackStyle; motion fixture starts idle
conditions.landing: aerial landing cancels attack; observedLandingLag lands on the first active frame; autocancelWindows is Melee's 1-based <before from>, landing outside it takes landingLag and inside it the empty landing lag
